nodes.title: How to use · v1.0.0
widgets_values:
# The_frizzy1 · H3 Singularity Swap · 12 GB · v1.0.0

Swaps **one real person** in your video for **the person in your photo**, keeps the room, the camera and the sound.
One H3 pass over the whole clip (up to 15 s), so there are no seams.

## How to use (App mode)
1. **Your video**: a 24 fps clip with no mirrors. Longest clip: 15 s.
2. **Person photo**: one sharp photo with a big face, plain background.
3. **Who to replace**: what SAM 3.1 looks for, e.g. *person* or *bald man*. The biggest match is taken.
4. **Describe the new person**: one line (hair, beard, glasses, outfit). **Full-body clip and your photo stops at the waist? Add the trousers and shoes** (e.g. *Dark jeans and sneakers.*). Without them Singularity made the head too big in my tests.
5. **Seconds**: 0 = whole clip. Try 3 s first.
6. **Short side**: 480 for speed, 736 for close-ups.
7. **Lip-sync**: on for talking, off for music.
8. Press **Run**. The result lands in `output/H3 simple swap/`.

## How it works
SAM 3.1 tracks the person. Qwen3-VL 8B looks at four frames and writes one line about the framing and the action, which Singularity needs to keep the pose and the size right. The person is turned into a grey figure (pose, hands, mouth, no face or clothes), H3 regenerates only the masked area from your photo and the grey figure. The prompt is OPENjutsu's Simple prompt with a realism line added, which you can edit in the graph (*Realism prompt*).

## Speed
RTX 3060 12 GB, cold start: **9.4 s** at 480×864 in **13:01**, **5.2 s** at 1312×736 in **12:13**, **3 s** at 768×736 in **5:18**.

## Credits
Mask, grey figure and prompt idea from [OPENjutsu](https://github.com/D3voz/openjutsu) by D3voz. Workflow by **The_frizzy1**: [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@the_frizzy1) · [workflows](https://github.com/Thefrizzy1/The_frizzy1-Workflows).

widgets_values:
# Downloads · put each file in the folder shown

Inside `ComfyUI/models/`. Click a file name to download it.

| Folder | File (click = download) | Size |
|---|---|---|
| `diffusion_models/` | [Minimax-h3_Singularity_ref2va_v2_pruned_int8.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/WarmBloodAban/Minimax-h3_Singularity/resolve/main/Minimax-h3_Singularity_ref2va_v2_pruned_int8.safetensors) | 21.0 GB |
| `loras/` | [minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/loras/minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.safetensors) | 2.0 GB |
| `text_encoders/` | [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors) | 15.7 GB |
| `text_encoders/` | [qwen3vl_8b_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen3-VL/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_8b_int8_convrot.safetensors) | 9.4 GB |
| `vae/` | [minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors) | 2.8 GB |
| `vae/` | [minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors) | 0.6 GB |
| `checkpoints/` | [sam3.1_multiplex_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/sam3.1/resolve/main/checkpoints/sam3.1_multiplex_fp16.safetensors) | 1.7 GB |

Total: 53.2 GB. If you already run H3, you only need the first file.
Plain H3 works in the same slot: `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`.

**Custom nodes (2):** [comfyui-h3-oneclick-swap](https://github.com/D3voz/comfyui-h3-oneclick-swap) (person mask, grey figure) and [ComfyUI-Fantastic-MiniMaxH3-PromptBuilder](https://github.com/Adudeguyman/ComfyUI-Fantastic-MiniMaxH3-PromptBuilder) (masked edit latent).

## Requirements
- **GPU:** 12 GB VRAM tested. The 21 GB model does not fit in 12 GB: ComfyUI streams the rest from system RAM.
- **RAM:** 32 GB tested.
- **ComfyUI:** 0.43.1 tested.

_Tested on: RTX 3060 12 GB · Ryzen 5 5600X · 32 GB RAM · ComfyUI 0.43.1 · Windows 11._

Singularity is by [WarmBloodAban](https://huggingface.co/WarmBloodAban/Minimax-h3_Singularity), built on MiniMax H3 (MiniMax H3 Community License).
